seo.description: Proactive 24/7 network monitoring, firewall & Wi-Fi health checks, configuration backup and engineer review for Seattle businesses. Custom-quoted plans.

items.a: Depending on your plan, monitoring can cover Internet availability, firewalls, switches, wireless access points and VPN status, with configuration backup and regular health reports.
Yes. Automated monitoring runs 24/7 and alerts on availability and health issues. Engineer review and configuration-change allowances depend on the plan you choose.

Essential focuses on monitoring and reporting, with engineering billed separately. Professional adds a monthly engineer review and up to 1 hour of network configuration changes per month. Enterprise is scoped individually.
